_meta.name: OFFICE iQ — DSA problems DUMMY TEMPLATE (rules-only, no real content)
_meta.purpose: Upload via the admin Catalog screen's Content step 'Upload DSA problems JSON' button (POST /api/admin/catalog/:id/content/dsa, ADR 0027) to add/replace DSA problems on an EXISTING catalog entry that already has tickets uploaded — or pick this file separately as the 'DSA problems file (.json, optional)' in the same 'Add workspace' modal as company-tickets-template.json to include it in a brand-new entry (POST /api/admin/catalog/import, ADR 0009; the two files are merged client-side, no need to combine them yourself). This `_meta` block is ignored on import.
howToUse: 1. Replace the sample entries with real ones — each item carries its own `day` (1..30), no duplicate days, at most 30 total.
2. Delete this `_meta` block (optional — it's stripped automatically) and upload.

hardLimits.dsaProblems: 1 to 30 items (the button requires at least one)

notes: As of ADR 0027, `day` links a DSA problem to a simulation day directly — it is matched onto that day's ticket(s) at *read* time, not denormalised onto the ticket at upload time. Previously (ADR 0009) DSA problems were paired onto tickets positionally when `day` was omitted; that positional fallback still works the same way here (1st item = day 1, 2nd = day 2, ...) if you omit `day`, but setting it explicitly is safer.
This upload PATCHES the current active content pack in place — tickets and the quiz pool are left exactly as they were, no new pack version is created.

The catalog entry must already have tickets uploaded (via the Tickets button or 'Add workspace') before DSA can be uploaded — otherwise the request fails with a 422 telling you to upload tickets first.
Malformed items make the whole upload fail with a 422 and a `details` array listing every problem found — no partial write.
Only 1 sample is shown to keep this template short — copy the object to add more, up to the 30 hard limit.
